content.short: Fetch.ai builds tools and a Cosmos-based chain for AI agents that find, negotiate and transact with each other using FET.
content.description: Fetch.ai has worked on autonomous agents since 2017. Its uAgents framework and the Agentverse platform let developers build agents that can search, negotiate and complete transactions for people. Those agents register and settle on Fetch.ai's Cosmos SDK chain, with FET used for fees and staking. Fetch.ai is a founding member of the Artificial Superintelligence Alliance and runs the ASI:One assistant. Its consumer side is a personal AI that books flights, reserves dinners and manages calendars by calling on brand agents, showing which agent handles each part of a request before the user approves it.
